description: [Requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY] Search for YouTube videos with advanced filtering options. Supports parameters: - query: Search term (required) - maxResults: Number of results to return (1-50) - channelId: Filter by specific channel - order: Sort by date, rating, viewCount, relevance, title - type: Filter by resource type (video, channel, playlist) - videoDuration: Filter by length (short: <4min, medium: 4-20min, long: >20min) - publishedAfter/publishedBefore: Filter by publish date (ISO format) - videoCaption: Filter by caption availability - videoDefinition: Filter by quality (standard/high) - regionCode: Filter by country (ISO country code)
name: search-videos
